signals.content: Real-time tracking of every new GitHub 'skills' repo to capture the AI agent skill ecosystem trend
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; implementation ecosystem relevance. Final score: 65. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: linny006/skills-tracker
Brief: This open‑source tool monitors GitHub for newly created repositories containing the keyword “skills”. By aggregating timestamps, language tags, and README metadata, it provides a real‑time view of emerging AI agent skill sets and their adoption rates. The data can support OSINT analysts in mapping the evolving skill ecosystem, identifying nascent capabilities, and informing strategic decisions. Coverage is limited to publicly visible repos and may miss private or undocumented projects.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: linny006/skills-tracker
الملخص: هذه الأداة مفتوحة المصدر تراقب GitHub لاكتشاف المستودعات الجديدة التي تحمل كلمة "skills". من خلال تجميع الطوابع الزمنية، وسوم اللغات، وبيانات README، توفر رؤية لحظية للمهارات الناشئة لوكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي ومعدلات اعتمادها. يمكن للمحللين في مجال OSINT استخدام هذه البيانات لرسم خريطة لنظام المهارات المتطور، وتحديد القدرات الصاعدة، ودعم اتخاذ القرارات الاستراتيجية. يقتصر التغطية على المستودعات العامة وقد لا تشمل المشاريع الخاصة أو غير الموثقة.

Title: mehrotra0307/agent-referee
Summary: A free, framework‑agnostic toolkit that lets you attach any AI agent to a real‑time evaluation scoring system, enforce guardrails, and capture observability traces within minutes. No signup required and it never accesses your API key, making it suitable for rapid, low‑risk OSINT and strategic testing of AI behaviours.
Key Points:
- Plug‑and‑play integration with any agent architecture.
- Immediate scoring against predefined metrics and safety guardrails.
- Full traceability of inputs, outputs, and intermediate states.
- Open‑source, 100% free, no credential collection.
- Ideal for quick, controlled assessments without exposing sensitive keys.

العنوان: mehrotra0307/agent-referee
ملخص: أداة مجانية وغير مرتبطة بإطار عمل معين تتيح ربط أي وكيل ذكاء اصطناعي بنظام تقييم فوري، وتطبيق حواجز أمان، وتسجيل تتبع المراقبة خلال دقائق. لا تحتاج إلى تسجيل ولا تتعامل مع مفتاح API الخاص بك، ما يجعلها مناسبة لتقييمات OSINT السريعة والاستراتيجية لسلوكيات الذكاء الاصطناعي مع الحد الأدنى من المخاطر.

- تكامل فوري مع أي بنية للوكيل.
- تقييم فوري وفق مقاييس محددة وحواجز أمان.

signals.brief_en:
Title: Quor-a/ZorvAI
ZorvAI is an open‑source Android AI agent built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It supports multi‑model conversations, a personality system, persistent memory, full‑duplex voice (TTS/STT), scheduled tasks, extensible toolchains, and integration with Feishu, QQ, and WeChat. The platform is positioned as a modular, OSINT‑friendly assistant for strategic information gathering and analysis, though its real‑world performance and coverage remain to be independently verified.

ZorvAI هو وكيل ذكاء اصطناعي مفتوح المصدر لنظام Android تم تطويره باستخدام Kotlin وJetpack Compose. يدعم محادثات متعددة النماذج، نظام شخصية، ذاكرة مستمرة، صوت كامل الثنائي (تحويل نص إلى كلام/كلام إلى نص)، مهام مجدولة، سلاسل أدوات قابلة للتوسيع، وتكامل مع Feishu وQQ وWeChat. يُصمم كأداة موحدة صديقة للـ OSINT لتجميع وتحليل المعلومات الاستراتيجية، مع الإشارة إلى أن فعاليته الفعلية ونطاق تغطيته لا تزال بحاجة إلى تقييم مستقل.

signals.brief_en:
Title: idontknow684/Miyabi_AI_Agent

Brief: The Miyabi AI Agent framework focuses on improving AI performance through systematic prompt engineering, modular tool integration, and reusable hook creation. It provides a structured methodology for designing prompts that elicit precise outputs, organizing auxiliary tools (APIs, scripts, databases) into clear pipelines, and implementing hooks that enable dynamic context switching and task automation. The approach is grounded in open‑source intelligence (OSINT) practices, emphasizing verifiable data sources and transparent evaluation metrics. While early adopters report increased response relevance and reduced iteration cycles, the framework’s efficacy varies with domain complexity and data quality, and further empirical validation is ongoing.

signals.title: @Cybernews: Anthropic appears to be building a broader surveillance system to monitor activists who oppose the rapid growth of AI, according to job post
signals.content: Anthropic appears to be building a broader surveillance system to monitor activists who oppose the rapid growth of AI, according to job postings and interviews with senior security staff. The system reportedly tracks protests and activity near Anthropic executives and facilities, while also using a “pre-crime” approach to predict incidents before they happen. In some cases, suspected individuals may be reported to police before any crime occurs. Anthropic’s reported monitoring efforts mark a notable shift from its previous opposition to government surveillance. Earlier this year, the company clashed with the Department of Defense after refusing to allow its AI tools to be used for mass domestic surveillance or autonomous weapons. The surveillance system was first reported by The American Prospect, which based its findings on interviews with senior Anthropic security officials and an analysis of the company’s job postings.
